# Feature
## When to use
Requested behavior changes.
## Required context
Affected code and rules.
## Preconditions
Keep active approvals.
## Procedure
Define claims; choose a sibling pattern. For known behavior, run a failing test,
then implement the smallest complete fix. Activate `feature-development` for details.
## Tools
Project checks and diff.
## Rules
Preserve trust boundaries.
## Verification
Run focused tests; inspect side effects.
## Evidence
Commands, results and gaps.
## Completion criteria
Claims have proof or explicit limits.
## Failure modes
Unresolved product choice: escalate.
## References
[Implementation detail](references/playbook.md).


## Paved integration

Use the project-local Paved contract as the source of truth. Discover state with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" status --json`, load only relevant `.paved/project/` context, and invoke verification with `node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/paved.mjs" verify --json`. Always run it from the repository being worked on, never from the plugin directory. Do not edit generated integration files or bypass Paved lifecycle and ownership checks.
